thesis: The stock is extended after a roughly 39% 63-day run and an earnings gap whose driver is undocumented, and it sits near the mean analyst target with only a 1.5 reward/risk. The pre-market price of 38.44 is above the 36.9-37.9 entry zone, so buying now means chasing into resistance at 39.7 while volume fades. Balance sheet is heavy (debt/equity 112, trailing margin -33%) and short interest of about 32% of float makes reversals violent. The regime is risk-off with QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, VIX at the 0.858 percentile and 10-year yield near the top of its range, so a high-beta, levered small/mid cap is vulnerable to a de-rating and to a gap fill toward 33.84.
